title: Principia Structurae Realitatis: A Structural Reasoning Framework for Whole-System Coordination in LLMs
description: Principia Structurae Realitatis is an open research framework built around the structural expression Reality = Consciousness × Matter × Coordination. For AI use, the expression is treated as a generative reasoning seed rather than ordinary arithmetic. The public framework focuses on whole-system coordination, constraint retention, dependency propagation, contradiction detection, local-versus-global feasibility, reasoning-policy stability, and controlled A/B testing across large language models.
